scientific_integrity: The theorem and its analytic proof concern unassisted energy-constrained capacities for a discrete binary phase-noise model. The general degradable-channel coding theorem is credited to Wilde and Qi. Finite numerical assertions only corroborate formulae; no independent audit or literature-wide priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only independent binary phase kicks (0 or pi), with no photon loss or temporal memory.
Finite positive mean photon-energy constraint E, and singular asymptotics at fixed E.
No assertion about two-way assisted capacities, general phase laws, hard energy cutoffs, or finite-block operational performance.
title: Singular parity activation of energy-constrained bosonic quantum communication
